description.en:
A placeable Fertilizer Depot where you can buy, store, and sell all fertilizer types at seasonally-adjusted prices. Drive up with your trailer or tank, browse the full selection of fertilizers, and fill up directly from depot storage. Works seamlessly with FS25_SoilFertilizer ÔÇö all 23+ custom fill types are automatically available. Falls back to vanilla fertilizer types if SoilFertilizer is not installed.
Features: - Buy all SF fertilizer types at seasonal prices - Per-type silo storage (50,000L per fill type) - Sell excess fertilizer back at 80% of buy price - Seasonal price fluctuation (Spring +15%, Winter -15%) - Full multiplayer support with server-authoritative transactions - FarmTablet integration via g_DepotManager global
